# BazarPOS — Offline-First Retail Management & POS Android Application

A complete, offline-first Retail Management & Point of Sale (POS) Android application built in **Kotlin**, **Jetpack Compose (Material 3)**, and **Room SQLite**, tailored for retail shops in Bangladesh (`Asia/Dhaka` timezone, `৳ BDT`, English & বাংলা bilingual UI and thermal receipts).

## Core Architecture

- **UI**: Jetpack Compose + Material 3 (`Light` & `Dark` themes, English & Bangla resources)
- **State Management**: MVVM + `StateFlow` / `SharedFlow`
- **Persistence**: Room SQLite (`PosDatabase`) with 12 relational tables, foreign keys, unique constraints (`barcode`, `billNumber`, `mobile`), and `@Transaction` atomic checkout/exchange/stock operations.
- **Offline Security**: First-launch Administrator Password setup using `PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256` with random 16-byte salt, configurable authorization rules, and immutable `AuditLogEntity` records.
- **Unified Barcode Pipeline**:
  1. Mobile Camera via **CameraX + Google ML Kit** (offline model, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, QR Code)
  2. **USB OTG HID** external scanners (intercepted via `Activity.dispatchKeyEvent`)
  3. **Bluetooth HID** scanners (intercepted via `Activity.dispatchKeyEvent`)
- **Thermal Printing**: Universal Bluetooth Classic SPP (`00001101-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`) ESC/POS printing for **58mm** & **80mm** printers, including **bitmap raster fallback (`GS v 0`)** for crisp Bengali return policy printing on printers without built-in Bangla codepages, plus Android `PrintManager` PDF fallback.
- **Backup & Restore**: Offline SQLite backup and restore via Android Storage Access Framework (SAF), plus UTF-8 BOM CSV exports for products, vendors, sales, and reports.

## Bill Numbering & Exchange Rules

- Bill numbers follow `YYYYMMDD-001` in `Asia/Dhaka` timezone and reset daily while remaining unique across restarts.
- Return & Exchange Policy (printed in English & Bangla on every receipt):
  - *"Products may be exchanged within 3 days of purchase with the original bill. No cash refund is available."*
  - *"ক্রয়ের ৩ দিনের মধ্যে মূল বিলসহ পণ্য এক্সচেঞ্জ করা যাবে। কোনো নগদ টাকা ফেরত দেওয়া হবে না।"*

## Building the APK (Android Studio / GitHub Codespaces)

1. Open the `android-pos` folder in **Android Studio Ladybug (2024.2+)** or a Linux Codespace with JDK 17 + Android SDK 35.
2. Ensure `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` is present (if missing, run `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.9` or let Android Studio sync download it automatically).
3. Build the debug APK:
   ```bash
   chmod +x gradlew
   ./gradlew assembleDebug
   ```
4. Output APK path:
   ```text
   app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
   ```

## Uploading to GitHub

```bash
cd android-pos
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial BazarPOS Android Studio project"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/<your-repo>.git
git push -u origin main
```

## Environment & Hardware Verification Notice

- This web container does not include JDK/Android SDK or physical Bluetooth/USB POS hardware, so `./gradlew assembleDebug` and physical hardware scans/prints have **not** been executed in this container.
- All pure retail domain math (GP%, daily bill numbering, 3-day exchange eligibility, stock deduction, cart totals, report aggregation, and receipt formatting) is verified in the companion TypeScript test suite and interactive web simulator.

#!/bin/sh
#
# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
#

DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'
APP_NAME="Gradle"
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
APP_HOME=$(cd "${0%/*}" && pwd -P) || exit

# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
    JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
else
    JAVACMD="java"
fi

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

if [ ! -f "$CLASSPATH" ]; then
    echo "Downloading gradle-wrapper.jar..."
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        curl -fsSL -o "$CLASSPATH" "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v8.9.0/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" || true
    fi
fi

exec "$JAVACMD" $DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" -classpath "$CLASSPATH" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain "$@"

@rem Gradle startup script for Windows
@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off
setlocal
set DIRNAME=%~dp0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"
set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe
set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=gradlew" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*
endlocal

package com.bazarpos.retail.data.local.entity

import androidx.room.Embedded
import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.ForeignKey
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey
import androidx.room.Relation

@Entity(
    tableName = "vendors",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["vendorCode"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["name"])
    ]
)
data class VendorEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val vendorCode: String,
    val name: String,
    val contactPerson: String,
    val mobile: String,
    val altPhone: String = "",
    val address: String = "",
    val notes: String = "",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "categories",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["categoryCode"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["name"], unique = true)
    ]
)
data class CategoryEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val categoryCode: String,
    val name: String,
    val description: String = "",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "subcategories",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = CategoryEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["categoryId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["subcategoryCode"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["categoryId"])
    ]
)
data class SubcategoryEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val subcategoryCode: String,
    val categoryId: Long,
    val name: String,
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "products",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = VendorEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["vendorId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        ),
        ForeignKey(
            entity = CategoryEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["categoryId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        ),
        ForeignKey(
            entity = SubcategoryEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["subcategoryId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.SET_NULL
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["productCode"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["barcode"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["vendorId"]),
        Index(value = ["categoryId"]),
        Index(value = ["subcategoryId"]),
        Index(value = ["name"])
    ]
)
data class ProductEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val productCode: String,
    val vendorId: Long,
    val categoryId: Long,
    val subcategoryId: Long? = null,
    val barcode: String,
    val name: String,
    val description: String = "",
    val purchasePrice: Double,
    val sellingPrice: Double,
    val gpAmount: Double,
    val gpPercentage: Double,
    val currentStock: Double,
    val minStockAlert: Double = 5.0,
    val unit: String = "piece",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "customers",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["mobile"], unique = true)
    ]
)
data class CustomerEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val name: String,
    val mobile: String,
    val totalSpent: Double = 0.0,
    val billCount: Int = 0,
    val lastPurchaseAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "sales",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = CustomerEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["customerId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.SET_NULL
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["billNumber"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["billDateKey"]),
        Index(value = ["customerId"]),
        Index(value = ["customerMobile"]),
        Index(value = ["createdAt"])
    ]
)
data class SaleEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val billNumber: String,
    val billDateKey: String,
    val customerId: Long? = null,
    val customerName: String = "",
    val customerMobile: String = "",
    val subtotal: Double,
    val discountAmount: Double = 0.0,
    val grandTotal: Double,
    val totalQuantity: Double,
    val status: String = "COMPLETED", // COMPLETED, EXCHANGED, CANCELLED
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "sale_items",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = SaleEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["saleId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE
        ),
        ForeignKey(
            entity = ProductEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["productId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["saleId"]),
        Index(value = ["productId"])
    ]
)
data class SaleItemEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val saleId: Long,
    val productId: Long,
    val productName: String,
    val barcode: String,
    val unit: String,
    val quantity: Double,
    val unitPrice: Double,
    val purchasePriceAtSale: Double,
    val subtotal: Double
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "stock_movements",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = ProductEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["productId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["productId"]),
        Index(value = ["createdAt"]),
        Index(value = ["referenceBillId"])
    ]
)
data class StockMovementEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val productId: Long,
    val productName: String,
    val barcode: String,
    val movementType: String, // INITIAL, PURCHASE, SALE, ADJUSTMENT, EXCHANGE_RETURN, EXCHANGE_OUT
    val quantity: Double,
    val previousStock: Double,
    val newStock: Double,
    val referenceBillId: String = "",
    val authorizedByAdmin: Boolean = false,
    val note: String = "",
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "exchanges",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = SaleEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["originalSaleId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["originalSaleId"]),
        Index(value = ["exchangeNumber"], unique = true)
    ]
)
data class ExchangeEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val exchangeNumber: String,
    val originalSaleId: Long,
    val originalBillNumber: String,
    val returnedTotal: Double,
    val replacementTotal: Double,
    val netDifference: Double,
    val reason: String = "",
    val authorizedByAdmin: Boolean = true,
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "exchange_items",
    foreignKeys = [
        ForeignKey(
            entity = ExchangeEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["exchangeId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE
        ),
        ForeignKey(
            entity = ProductEntity::class,
            parentColumns = ["id"],
            childColumns = ["productId"],
            onDelete = ForeignKey.RESTRICT
        )
    ],
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["exchangeId"]),
        Index(value = ["productId"])
    ]
)
data class ExchangeItemEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val exchangeId: Long,
    val productId: Long,
    val productName: String,
    val barcode: String,
    val direction: String, // RETURNED, REPLACEMENT
    val quantity: Double,
    val unitPrice: Double,
    val subtotal: Double
)

@Entity(tableName = "app_settings")
data class AppSettingsEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val id: Int = 1,
    val storeName: String = "BazarPOS Retail Store",
    val storeAddress: String = "Dhaka, Bangladesh",
    val storePhone: String = "+880 1700-000000",
    val storeLogoUri: String = "",
    val currencySymbol: String = "৳",
    val language: String = "en", // "en" or "bn"
    val darkTheme: Boolean = false,
    val paperWidthMm: Int = 58, // 58 or 80
    val lastPrinterName: String = "",
    val lastPrinterAddress: String = "",
    val autoPrintReceipt: Boolean = true,
    val lowStockAlertEnabled: Boolean = true,
    val englishReturnPolicy: String = "Products may be exchanged within 3 days of purchase with the original bill. No cash refund is available.",
    val banglaReturnPolicy: String = "ক্রয়ের ৩ দিনের মধ্যে মূল বিলসহ পণ্য এক্সচেঞ্জ করা যাবে। কোনো নগদ টাকা ফেরত দেওয়া হবে না।",
    val receiptFooterNote: String = "Thank you for shopping with us!",
    val adminPasswordHash: String = "",
    val adminPasswordSalt: String = "",
    val protectProductOps: Boolean = true,
    val protectVendorOps: Boolean = true,
    val protectCategoryOps: Boolean = true,
    val protectStockAdjust: Boolean = true,
    val protectPosRemoval: Boolean = true,
    val protectPosDiscount: Boolean = true,
    val protectBillCancel: Boolean = true,
    val protectSensitiveReports: Boolean = false
)

@Entity(
    tableName = "audit_logs",
    indices = [Index(value = ["createdAt"])]
)
data class AuditLogEntity(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true) val id: Long = 0,
    val actionType: String,
    val targetReference: String,
    val details: String,
    val createdAt: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

// Relational POJOs
data class CategoryWithSubcategories(
    @Embedded val category: CategoryEntity,
    @Relation(
        parentColumn = "id",
        entityColumn = "categoryId"
    )
    val subcategories: List<SubcategoryEntity>
)

data class SaleWithItems(
    @Embedded val sale: SaleEntity,
    @Relation(
        parentColumn = "id",
        entityColumn = "saleId"
    )
    val items: List<SaleItemEntity>
)

data class ExchangeWithItems(
    @Embedded val exchange: ExchangeEntity,
    @Relation(
        parentColumn = "id",
        entityColumn = "exchangeId"
    )
    val items: List<ExchangeItemEntity>
)

package com.bazarpos.retail.domain

import android.util.Base64
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.security.SecureRandom
import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory
import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec

enum class ProtectedAction(val title: String) {
    REMOVE_CART_ITEM("Remove Product from Bill"),
    REDUCE_CART_QTY("Reduce Scanned Quantity"),
    CANCEL_BILL("Cancel Entire Bill"),
    CLEAR_CART("Clear POS Cart"),
    APPLY_DISCOUNT("Apply Discount"),
    OVERRIDE_STOCK("Sell Above Available Stock"),
    PRODUCT_SENSITIVE("Modify / Delete Product"),
    VENDOR_SENSITIVE("Modify / Delete Vendor"),
    CATEGORY_SENSITIVE("Modify / Delete Category"),
    STOCK_ADJUSTMENT("Adjust Inventory Stock"),
    PROCESS_EXCHANGE("Process 3-Day Exchange"),
    RESTORE_BACKUP("Restore Database Backup"),
    SENSITIVE_REPORTS("Access Profit & Margin Reports")
}

object SecurityManager {
    private const val ITERATIONS = 12000
    private const val KEY_LENGTH_BITS = 256
    private const val SALT_BYTES = 16

    fun createPasswordHash(password: String): Pair<String, String> {
        val salt = ByteArray(SALT_BYTES)
        SecureRandom().nextBytes(salt)
        val hash = pbkdf2(password.toCharArray(), salt)
        return Pair(
            Base64.encodeToString(hash, Base64.NO_WRAP),
            Base64.encodeToString(salt, Base64.NO_WRAP)
        )
    }

    fun verifyPassword(password: String, storedHashB64: String, storedSaltB64: String): Boolean {
        if (storedHashB64.isBlank() || storedSaltB64.isBlank()) return false
        val salt = Base64.decode(storedSaltB64, Base64.NO_WRAP)
        val expectedHash = Base64.decode(storedHashB64, Base64.NO_WRAP)
        val candidateHash = pbkdf2(password.toCharArray(), salt)
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(expectedHash, candidateHash)
    }

    private fun pbkdf2(chars: CharArray, salt: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val spec = PBEKeySpec(chars, salt, ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH_BITS)
        val factory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256")
        return factory.generateSecret(spec).encoded
    }
}
